title: Stargate travel

provenance.note: Stargate travel is cargo-less, fuel-free and single-year.

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 918463 (0x000e03bf), HLP file offset 233908 (0x000391b4), topic 105 'Stargate Navigation'

setup.baseline: Two owned planets with stargates of known type.
setup.variable: Ship mass, cargo, gate type and safety.

procedure: Send a cargo-less fleet through a gate and record travel time and fuel.
Add cargo and record whether it is allowed and how weight is computed.
Test Interstellar Traveler restrictions and gate-cost modifier.

documented: Stargates provide cargo-less, fuel-free, single-year transport between owned planets (documented-only).
Interstellar Traveler can transport cargo through gates and ignores cargo weight for gate limits (documented-only).

unresolved: Exact gate capacity, range and overload risk are not decoded.
The single-year timing relative to normal movement is unverified.
